'''Technical tool kits''',<ref name="RASB2">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> colloquially called '''tech kits''',<ref name="Blaze">{{JournalCite|8|Blaze of Glory (short story)}}</ref> were specialized [[Tool kit/Legends|tool kits]]. [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] [[Technicians/Legends|Technicians]] carried technical tool kits,<ref name="RASB2" /> as did [[Adri Reenogga]] of [[Reenogga Personal Services, Cubed]].<ref name="ZA">{{JournalCite|5|Zirtran's Anchor (article)}}</ref> [[Hugo Cutter]] also made use of a technical tool kit.<ref name="Blaze" />
